dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper-left dorsal area characterized by high-contrast light-intensity perimeters surrounding dark centers; the perimeters exhibit non-uniform thickness and irregular, jagged pixel boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of high-intensity (near-white) pixel clusters localized on the left lateral flank, forming a dense, vertically oriented band of solid signal without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Geometric arrangement of the five most distinct light-ringed centroids forms an irregular convex polygon across the dorsal-lateral plane.

other_distinctive_markers: The posterior flipper region exhibits a high-reflectance, silvery-grey pixel intensity contrasting sharply with the primary dark trunk, with clearly defined digital segments and high-contrast separation lines.
